seams.description: handler -> store boundary: every read/write goes through TodoStore methods; stage 2 adds the registration write path (webhook_url) and the done read/mutate path must keep behaving

mark_done -> webhook dispatch boundary: exactly one dispatch per successful transition, after the store mutation, inside a no-escape exception boundary; input side is the registered URL (T01's deliverable)

integration_tasks.notes: small plan: final_acceptance and contract_consistency merge into the e2e closure task — the closure run executes acceptance A1-A4 end to end and diffs the live responses against the frozen C1/C2 specs (the unmodified stage-1 suite is the consistency check). Seam defects found by the gates are recorded as deviations and returned to the owning leaf's checkpoint; T03 does not patch leaf code.

omitted_kinds.reason: no new production wiring exists: both production changes are in-place edits of app/api.py and app/store.py, and the dispatch reuses the existing WebhookDispatcher in app/webhooks.py — nothing new is registered, imported, or wired between components; both seams are exercised (including failure scenarios) by T03's E2E gates
evidence: repo-context-snapshot.json: the repo has exactly 4 production/test files; no leaf creates a new production file in an existing directory
stage-contract.json C3 + constraint: dispatch must reuse the existing app/webhooks.py dispatcher — no new HTTP client/worker/queue
e2e_gates E1/E2/E3 cover S1 and S2 with failure scenarios (unknown id 404, raising dispatcher, no-URL done)

e2e_gates.scenario: registration -> done round-trip: create a todo with webhook_url via the API, mark it done, assert the store record keeps the URL and done=true and exactly one C3 dispatch was logged; bad-input failure: marking an unknown id done returns 404 and dispatches nothing

dispatch failure tolerance (S2 failure scenario): with a dispatcher whose send() raises, the done transition still returns 200 and the store record is done; no-URL done (S1 input edge): zero dispatches, status 200

frozen-contract integrity + final acceptance: the unmodified stage-1 suite tests/test_api.py passes green; GET /todos per-todo key set is exactly {id,title,done}(+tag) with no last_notified_at; acceptance A1-A4 executed end to end and evidenced
e2e_gates.evidence: python -m unittest discover tests -v (frozen suite + new suites) + tests/test_e2e_notifications.py::test_c1_key_set_unchanged
